title: Falls after the move to single rooms: a ward audit
byline: Ward 7 audit group, an invented example

sections.heading: Background
paragraphs: Inpatient falls are among the harms most often reported on medical wards [@okafor2021]. Single rooms may make falls harder to see from the nursing station [@brennan2019; @ward2024].
The audit standard was set from the trust's falls policy and an earlier audit cycle [@ward2024].

sections.heading: Method
paragraphs: Incident reports for the six months before and after the move were read against the audit tool [@mistral2022], and the findings were grouped by time of day [@quill2025].

sections.heading: Findings
paragraphs: Falls at night rose after the move, the pattern an earlier ward study reported [@okafor2021; @brennan2019; @ward2024; @mistral2022].
